title: Multiplication Table
description:
Print the multiplication table for 7, from 7×1 to 7×10. Each line should be in the format `7 x N = result`.

**Expected output (first 3 lines):**
```
7 x 1 = 7
7 x 2 = 14
7 x 3 = 21
...
```
hint: Use a for loop from 1 to 10 and an f-string to format each line.
